title: Claude is helping me port Lego LOTR to Nintendo Switch in Rust
author: IamFL4K
selftext:
So im a huge LOTR fan and have finished the game a lot of times through my life. My girlfriend has a switch only so i wanted to play the game with her in the console, sadly switch has no port of lego lotr so i figured out i'd just use claude to help me port my own lego lotr from my library to switch.

Heres what we did in a couple hours already.
